statement.label: PIM.1.1#01
statement.requirement: The system SHALL include in its product description the main functionality, the intended use, the intended (target) audience, and the potential use of the user's personal data by the system.

statement.label: PIM.1.1#02
statement.requirement: The system SHALL provide screen shots that accurately depict the screens of the current version of the product.

statement.label: PIM.1.1#03
statement.requirement: The system SHALL provide product information before it is used by the consumer, to help the consumer decide whether the system is suitable.

statement.label: PIM.1.1#04
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD clearly state in its product description the human languages it supports.

statement.label: PIM.1.1#05
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD provide information about the publisher (persons or organizations) and SHOULD provide mechanisms for communicating with the publisher.

statement.label: PIM.1.1#06
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD disclose its sources of funding and any possible conflicts of interest, such as use of the system incentivizing the user to buy products or services from the publisher.

statement.label: PIM.1.1#07
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI functionality THEN the system SHALL state in its product description whether it uses AI functionality, what that functionality does, what data it uses, and whether AI output is used to inform health-related information, recommendations, or decisions.

statement.label: PIM.1.1#08
statement.requirement: IF the system uses an external AI service THEN the system SHALL state in its product description the limitations of its AI functionality, including the populations, conditions, or contexts for which the AI function was not evaluated.

statement.label: PIM.1.1#09
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI functionality THEN the system SHOULD disclose the provider or organization accountable for the AI-enabled feature and provide a mechanism to contact that organization about safety, privacy, or performance concerns.
